```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
qqweibull = function(X, main = "qqWeibull"){
  f = ecdf(X)
  t_seq = sort(X)
  x = log(t_seq[t_seq >= 0])
  y = log(- log(1 - f(t_seq[t_seq >= 0])))
  
  I = x < Inf & y < Inf
  x = x[I]
  y = y[I]  
  
  
  plot(x,y, main = main)
  
  M = lm(y ~ x)
  k = M$coefficients[2]
  lambda =  exp(- M$coefficients[1] / k)
  
  abline(M, lty = 2, col = "darkgray")

  
  return(c("k" = unname(k), "lambda" = unname(lambda)))
}

qqweibull(rweibull(10000, 2, 10))

qqgumbel = function(X){
  f = ecdf(X)
  t_seq = sort(X)
  x = t_seq
  y = -log(-log(f(t_seq)))
  

  I = x < Inf & y < Inf
  x = x[I]
  y = y[I]
  
  plot(x,y, main = "qqGumbel")
  
  M = lm(y ~ x)
  beta = 1 / M$coefficients[2]
  mu = - M$coefficients[1] * beta
  
  abline(M, lty = 2, col = "grey")
  
  return(c("beta" = unname(beta), "mu" = unname(mu)))
}

qqgumbel(rGumbel(10000, 3, 2))

```
```{r}
generate_points_binom = function(n, d) matrix(runif(d * n), nrow = n)


generate_points_pois = function(lambda, d){
  n = rpois(1, lambda)
  return(generate_points_binom(n, d))
}
```


```{r}
max_lifetimes_gudhi = function(Y, r = Inf){
  if (ncol(Y) > 3) stop("dimmension to large")
  if (nrow(Y) < 3) stop("to few points")
  
  cech = alphaComplexDiag(Y, printProgress = F)$diagram
  cech_finite = cech[2:nrow(cech), ]
  dims = cech_finite[, 1]
  births = cech_finite[, 2]
  deaths = cech_finite[, 3]
  lifetimes = sqrt(deaths) - sqrt(births) 
  output = numeric()
  
  i = 1
  
  for (d in 0:(ncol(Y) - 1)){
    if (!(d %in% dims)) output = c(output, NA)
    
    else{
      if (all((dims != d | sqrt(deaths) >= r))) output = c(output, NA) 
      
      else output = c(output, max(lifetimes[dims == d & sqrt(deaths) < r]))
    }
    
    names(output)[i] = paste("dim =", d)
    i = i + 1
  }
  return(output)
}
max_lifetimes_gudhi(generate_points_pois(30, 3), 0.2)

```


```{r}
sim_maxlifetimes_pois = function(n, r = Inf, nsim, d = 1, holedim = 0){
  output = numeric()
  for (i in 1:nsim){
    if (d == 1){
      while(TRUE){
        pts = generate_points_pois(n, d)
        if (length(pts) > 2) break
      }
      sim = lifetimes(pts)
      sim = sim[sim < r]
      if (length(sim) == 0) sim = NA
      else sim = max(sim)
      names(sim) = "dim = 0"
    }
    else{
      while(TRUE){
        pts = generate_points_pois(n, d)
        if (nrow(pts) > 2) break
        else next
      }
      sim = max_lifetimes_gudhi(pts, r)[holedim + 1]
      name = names(sim)
      if (length(sim) == 0) sim = NA
      else sim = max(sim)
      names(sim) = name
    }
    output = rbind(output, sim)
  }
  rownames(output) = 1:nrow(output)
  
  return(output)
}


sim_maxlifetimes_pois(60, 1, 10, 3, 2)
```

```{r}
generate_points_binom_circ = function(n, r = 1, center = c(0, 0, 0)){
  pts = matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = 3)
  colnames(pts) = c("x", "y", "z")
  i = 1
  while (is.na(pts[n, 1])){
    samp = runif(3, -r, r)
    if (sqrt(sum(samp^2)) <= r){
      pts[i, ] = samp + center
      i = i + 1
    }
  }
  return(pts)
}

generate_points_binom_circ(4, 1)
```


```{r}
generate_points_pois_circ = function(lambda, r = 1, center = c(0, 0, 0)){
  n = rpois(1, lambda)
  
  pts = generate_points_binom_circ(n, r, center)
  return(pts)
}
pts = generate_points_pois_circ(10000)
plot3d(pts[, 1], pts[, 2], pts[, 3])
```


```{r}
r_circ = (3 / (pi * 4))^(1 / 3)
```


```{r}
sim_maxlifetimes_pois_circ = function(n, r = Inf, nsim, holedim = 2, verbose = F){
  output = numeric()
  for (i in 1:nsim){
    while(TRUE){
        pts = generate_points_pois_circ(n, r = r_circ)
        if (nrow(pts) > 2) break
        else next
      }
      sim = max_lifetimes_gudhi(pts, r)[holedim + 1]
      name = names(sim)
      if (length(sim) == 0) sim = NA
      else sim = max(sim)
      names(sim) = name
      output = rbind(output, sim)
      
      if (0 == i %% 5 & verbose) cat(i, " ")

  }
  rownames(output) = 1:nrow(output)
  if (verbose) cat("\n")
  return(output)
}


sim_maxlifetimes_pois_circ(1000, 1/10, 10, 2)
```

```{r}
n = 10^5
r = n^(- 46 / 108)
nsim = 10^2
M_n_pois = sim_maxlifetimes_pois_circ(n, r, nsim)
```



```{r}
lifetimes_circ_optim = function(flat_pts){
  pts = matrix(flat_pts, ncol = 3, byrow = T)
  
  dists = sqrt(rowSums(pts^2))
  
  if (any(dists > r_circ)) return(-10^6)
  
  max_void = max_lifetimes_gudhi(pts)[3]
  
  if (is.na(max_void)) return(0)
  else return(max_void)
}

lifetimes_circ_optim(as.vector(t(generate_points_binom_circ(10, r_circ))))
```


```{r}

flatten = function(Y) as.vector(t(Y))

initial_guess = flatten(generate_points_binom_circ(4, r_circ))

lower = rep(-r_circ, length(initial_guess))
upper = rep(r_circ, length(initial_guess))


SA = optim_sa(lifetimes_circ_optim, start = initial_guess, 
               maximization = TRUE, trace = F,lower = lower ,upper = upper,
                control = list(ac_acc = 0.00001, t0 = 1000, r = 0.95, 
                               nlimit = 50000, maxgood = 1000))


```

```{r}
opt = matrix(SA$par, ncol = 3, byrow = T)
norms = function(pts) sqrt(rowSums(pts^2))
print(norms(opt))
print(r_circ)

plot3d(opt[, 1], opt[, 2], opt[, 3], 
       xlim = c(-r_circ, r_circ), ylim = c(- r_circ, r_circ), zlim = c(-r_circ, r_circ))
guess = matrix(initial_guess, ncol = 3, byrow = 3)
plot3d(guess[, 1], guess[, 2], guess[, 3], col = "red", add = T)

```

```{r}
sim_maxlifetimes_binom_circ = function(n, r = Inf, nsim, holedim = 2, verbose = F){
  output = numeric()
  for (i in 1:nsim){
      pts = generate_points_binom_circ(n, r = r_circ)
      sim = max_lifetimes_gudhi(pts, r)[holedim + 1]
      name = names(sim)
      if (length(sim) == 0) sim = NA
      else sim = max(sim)
      names(sim) = name
      output = rbind(output, sim)
      
      if (0 == i %% 5 & verbose) cat(i, " ")

  }
  rownames(output) = 1:nrow(output)
  if (verbose) cat("\n")
  return(output)
}


sim_maxlifetimes_binom_circ(1000, 1/10, 12, 2)
```
